topic.title: Org: roles, missions and policies
topic.shortdesc: The org chart of agent roles: the Chief of Staff, a lead for each business and specialists under each lead, with live numbers per role. Edit it here.

image.alt: The Org page: the Chief of Staff at the top and each business's lead and roles below, each card with open, done, cost and approval counts.

body.p: Each card shows a role's open tasks, tasks done and cost over the last days, and approvals waiting. Choose its title to see its tasks in the Inbox. Mission and tools shows what it is for, its autonomy notes, the kinds of work it owns, its skills and tools, its schedules, the names you can address it by in chat, and what it is measured on.
A role decides who does the work and what they can see. Whether an action runs or waits is decided by the business's policies.

Choose Edit. Changes apply to the next task, and each business keeps a history you can restore. Each business gets Add role, Policies and History; a pencil on each card edits that role. Choose Done when finished.
If a change saved in the app no longer fits a newer version of the code, the page warns you and the code's version runs until you save again or reset it.

dlentry.dd: The id is lower case with dashes and can't change later, because tasks keep it.
Making a role report to the Chief of Staff makes it the business's lead; the old lead then reports to it.
What the role is for and how it should behave. Both go into the agent's instructions.
Triage intents. Taking one from another role moves it here; unowned ones go to the lead.
Only these skills are in its workspace, and it can reach only these servers (Odoo, mail, calendar…).
The actions it is expected to propose.
Extra chat names, comma separated, as in trade: ….
Each fires a task for this role on a cron schedule, such as 0 7 * * 1-5 for 07:00 on weekdays, with the prompt you give it. Schedules can be turned on and off.

body.p: Remove deletes a role once no roles report to it. Its tasks stay and count as the lead's.
For each action type of a business, choose Waits for approval, Runs, listed in the digest or Runs straight away. Anything not listed sets the rest. Promote an action type once you trust it.
body.note: Work that started with an email, webhook or other outside message always waits for approval, whatever is set here.

body.p: Every save is a version. Restore brings back an older one; Reset to code goes back to how the code defines that part of the org. Neither loses anything: your changes stay in the history.
